groups.label: Syntakt Performance Mods: JOG page (CDJ / vinyl jog) + PERFORM (DJ filter, spectrum)
groups.info: TEST36b. Hold [TEMPO] (or push knob A in the TEMPO menu) for the JOG page: a platter that turns once a bar (12 o'clock = the one). A = the jog: spinning bends the tempo (and the pitch, [YES] = MASTER TEMPO for tempo only) and eases back by LOAD; pushing A touches the platter (BRAKE, HOLD, START; turn while pushed to walk the beat on). B = LOAD (the jog's weight: light snaps back in ~0.3 s, heavy coasts ~2.3 s), C = START, D = BRAKE, E = RANGE (6/10/16/WIDE), F = PHASE (an exact nudge); G, H nothing. LOAD steps every 3 detents, RANGE every 6, START, BRAKE and PHASE every 2. SETTINGS > PERSONALIZE > JOG DISPLAY: VINYL or CDJ, the look only (CDJ: the inside turns with the platter; the outer ring of strobe dots, as VINYL's, and the tick ring only while the jog moves the tempo; a push brakes in both). [FUNC] + [TRIG 1-4] = 130/140/150/160 BPM, [FUNC] + [NO] = back, gliding over GLD bars ([FUNC] + G); phrase counter ([FUNC] + H). [RIGHT] = PERFORM, the whole screen, with its own knobs (nothing else changes JOG): A a DJ filter (LP2 left, THRU centre, HP2 right, a hard stop at each end; smooth like an analog knob: 16-bit cutoff, gliding; push = THRU, [FUNC] + push = off), B RESO; the filter's curve over the mix's spectrum (20 Hz - 20 kHz). The filter is the analog FX block over the whole mix, as the master filter (FX AMP, DRIVE and levels as with it). With Master filter ticked, PERFORM drives that one (its FX SYN page 2 stays); without it, perf-filter: the same audio with no page, no MIDI, nothing on the FX track's pages. Internal clock only; MIDI clock out follows. No LINK.
groups.why: New in TEST35a; checked in the emulator only, not on your unit yet.
groups.busy_what: the clock's rate and the bar position each audio block; ~730 more while PERFORM's spectrum is on screen, ~330 while the filter is on (perf-filter), more while you jog or a glide runs

notes.latest: TEST35a: Syntakt Performance Mods: the JOG page without LINK (B LOAD, C START, D BRAKE, E RANGE, F PHASE; detents; LOAD = weight, no slow tail; CDJ rings turn; PERSONALIZE sets VINYL / CDJ) and PERFORM's smooth DJ filter with its curve over the mix's spectrum; perf-filter (PERFORM's filter without a page) when Master filter isn't ticked. TEST34a: pause, phrase counter, pitch follow (MASTER TEMPO), brake fade, smoother A / H, tempo memories 130-160 + reset with an exact glide, PERFORM page (DJ filter on the master filter, snap). TEST33a: LINK: the CDJ bridge's phase meter on the JOG page, LOCK (own clock steered onto the master) and SYNC (the bridge's clock), knob F; other MIDI in untouched. TEST32a: the jog moves to its own JOG page (hold [TEMPO]) with a turning platter; VINYL touch (BRAKE / HOLD / START), LOAD, RANGE, PHASE; PERSONALIZE > JOG DISPLAY; the TEMPO menu is stock again (no fine tempo). TEST31a: added in the TEMPO menu.
check: Hold [TEMPO]: JOG. Turn B, C, D, E, F: LOAD, START, BRAKE, RANGE, PHASE; each needs 2-3 detents a step, so nothing skips. G and H do nothing.
LOAD 1 vs LOAD 8: spin A and let go: light snaps back in ~0.3 s, heavy coasts ~2.3 s, no long tail at the end.
SETTINGS > PERSONALIZE > JOG DISPLAY = CDJ: the rings turn with the platter, a push of A does nothing. VINYL: the record, a push brakes.
[RIGHT]: PERFORM. Turn B slowly both ways: the sweep should feel like an analog knob (no steps), stop at THRU in the middle, then the other side.
PERFORM's graph: the curve follows B and C; play a pattern: the spectrum moves, the bass drops away as you close the low-pass. Does the screen keep up? Do other pages stay smooth?
Your set: PERFORM drives your master filter (FX SYN page 2 still works and takes it back when you turn its FREQ). The alone files: PERFORM's own filter, no FX page.

1.41.why: TEST26: TEST21d (your pinned 1.41 build) + the GRID playhead and the compressors on the FX page; TEST27 adds SY SID (off by default); TEST30a adds SynCrackd (ported) and the DMA crash catcher (both off by default); the changed parts are labelled.

modarea.name: modarea
modarea.description: Area mod: all'avvio decomprime (SHLZ) le mod accodate alla sezione 3 (0x40348000) nel primo blocco dell'heap dell'OS (0x444e38d0, 131056 B, resto azzerato), che prenota alla prima allocazione.

patches.what: azzeramento del BSS: jmp modarea_load ; nop (decompressione, BSS a zero tranne l'area)
fine dell'inizializzazione dell'heap: jsr modarea_reserve ; nop (prima allocazione = area mod)

midi-guard.name: midi-guard
midi-guard.description: Keeps fx3, master-comp, beat-repeat and master-filter off the stock pages whose ids they borrow (MIDI machine SRC and CC SELECT 246-253, 262-269; IMPULSE REP/NUM/SHP/HOLD 445/446/443/442; COL 402/406/412; NLEV/NDEC 431/432): those ids are the mods' only on the FX track (and the FX3 page); elsewhere the stock descriptors, objects and kit functions are restored. The context follows the active track of the UI page views (switch called by vparams from is-kit).

vparams.name: vparams
vparams.description: Parametri virtuali delle mod: agganci alle funzioni centrali dei parametri di kit e tabella di registrazione in RAM. v2: gli id 246..269 (pagine della macchina MIDI) sono della mod solo sulla traccia FX (midi-guard). v4: e sulla pagina FX3 (REVERB pagina 2) da qualsiasi traccia.

perf-filter.name: perf-filter
perf-filter.description: Syntakt Performance Mods: the master filter for the JOG page's PERFORM page only (the analog FX block as an end-of-chain DJ filter, Polivoks RESO). No page, no parameters, no MIDI. Same hook as master-filter: with master-filter in the build, PERFORM uses that instead.

patches.what: audio interrupt: the FX filter CV routine's call -> pf_fx_hook (PERFORM's filter edits the copy of the live values, calls the OS routine, then rewrites its resonance CV)

tempojog-nolink.name: tempojog-nolink
tempojog-nolink.description: Syntakt Performance Mods: JOG page (hold [TEMPO], or push knob A in the TEMPO menu): A = the jog (spin: a bend that follows the spin and eases back by LOAD; VINYL: push = touch, BRAKE / HOLD / START), B = LOAD, C = START, D = BRAKE, E = RANGE, F = PHASE. SETTINGS > PERSONALIZE > JOG DISPLAY: VINYL / CDJ (look and behaviour). [RIGHT]: PERFORM, a DJ filter on the master filter (perf-filter or master-filter) with its curve over the mix's spectrum. Internal clock only. Without LINK (no CDJ bridge code, MIDI inputs stock).

patches.what: (mod area) tj.c: the JOG / PERFORM drawing
(mod area) tj.c: the pitch, the glide, the keys
audio interrupt: the copy of the live values -> tj_copy (TUNE follows the jog, VOL fades on a brake; MASTER TEMPO on = stock)
audio interrupt, internal clock: the tempo word read -> tj_rate_isr (the jog)
TEMPO view encoder handler: the JOG page's knobs A-H -> tj_enc
TEMPO view vtable slot 0 (destructor) -> tj_dtor0 (JOG ends)
TEMPO view vtable slot 1 (deleting destructor) -> tj_dtor1
TEMPO view vtable slot 2 (keys) -> tj_key (hold [TEMPO] = JOG)
boot: the PERSONALIZE menu's constructor -> tj_pers_v (+ JOG DISPLAY)
